articles.title_cn: 人工智能和我们的经济未来
articles.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) will likely be the most transformative technology of the modern era. What if machines—AI for cognitive tasks and AI plus advanced robots for physical tasks—can perform every task a human can? This essay makes three main points. First, even though US growth rates have been stable at roughly 2 percent per year for 150 years, it is distinctly possible that automating intelligence leads economic growth rates to accelerate. Second, this acceleration is likely to be slowed by the presence of "weak links." While we each have access to 100 million times more transistors on our desktop computer than people in the 1970s, we are not 100 million times more productive. Computers can invert matrices at lightning speed, but we humans must still decide what matrix to invert, what hypothesis to test, and so on. Accelerating economic growth requires the vast majority of the weak links to be automated away, which delays the large gains. Finally, even though weak links slow the benefits, they may actually speed up the risks. When a chain is only as strong as its weakest link, damaging one link in the chain can be very costly. A powerful AI that is superhuman at software engineering could be misused by a bad actor to do substantial harm by hacking the financial system or a virology lab.
articles.abstract_cn: 人工智能 (AI) 可能是现代最具变革性的技术。如果机器（用于认知任务的人工智能和用于物理任务的人工智能加上先进的机器人）能够执行人类可以执行的所有任务，会怎样？这篇文章主要讲了三个观点。首先，尽管美国的增长率在2%年里一直稳定在每年大约150，但自动化智能显然有可能导致经济增长率加速。其次，这种加速可能会因“薄弱环节”的存在而减慢。虽然我们每个人在台式计算机上使用的晶体管比 100 中的人多 1970 万倍，但我们的生产力并没有 100 万倍。计算机可以以闪电般的速度反转矩阵，但我们人类仍然必须决定要反转什么矩阵，要检验什么假设，等等。加速经济增长需要将绝大多数薄弱环节自动化消除，从而延迟了巨大收益的实现。最后，尽管薄弱环节减缓了收益，但它们实际上可能会加速风险。当一条链条的强度取决于其最薄弱的一环时，损坏链条中的一个环节可能会付出高昂的代价。在软件工程方面超人的强大人工智能可能会被不良行为者滥用，通过入侵金融系统或病毒学实验室来造成重大损害。

articles.title_en: The Emerging Market for Intelligence: How Firms Buy and Sell AI
articles.title_cn: 新兴的人工智能市场：企业如何买卖人工智能
articles.abstract_en: We describe the emerging business-to-business market for large language model (LLM) inference and document key empirical patterns in its supply, pricing, and dynamics, using data from OpenRouter. First, supply has expanded rapidly: the number of commercially available models, model creators, and inference providers has grown sharply, driven heavily by open-source entrants. Second, the price of intelligence has fallen roughly a thousandfold, and open-source models now cost about 90 percent less than comparable closed-source ones. Third, the market is highly dynamic, with frequent turnover among leading models and creators. Fourth, we document substantial horizontal and vertical differentiation: no single model dominates across use cases, and demand for intelligence varies widely across applications. We place these patterns in historical perspective alongside earlier general-purpose technologies.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用来自 OpenRouter 的数据描述了大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理的新兴企业对企业市场，并记录了其供应、定价和动态方面的关键经验模式。首先，供应迅速扩大：在开源进入者的大力推动下，商业模型、模型创建者和推理提供商的数量急剧增长。其次，情报的价格已经下降了大约一千倍，开源模型的成本现在比同类闭源模型低约 90%。第三，市场活跃度高，领军模特、创作者更替频繁。第四，我们记录了显着的水平和垂直差异：没有单一模型在用例中占主导地位，并且不同应用程序对智能的需求差异很大。我们将这些模式与早期的通用技术放在历史的角度来看。

articles.title_cn: 自1789以来的美国关税政策
articles.abstract_en: We use a newly assembled, tariff-line-level dataset spanning the full history of US trade policy to revisit the evolution of tariffs since 1789. We document the institutional shift from Congressional setting to multilateral negotiation, the steady growth in granularity of the tariff code alongside expanding administrative capacity, and the under-appreciated role of specific tariffs, which feature prominently throughout US history and whose ad valorem equivalent moves mechanically with prices. We discuss the implications of this relationship for how we interpret past liberalization episodes and for empirical identification of tariff effects. Finally, we outline how the new data can advance research on the political economy of tariff-setting and on the macroeconomic and distributional consequences of trade policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用新组装的涵盖美国贸易政策完整历史的关税线级别数据集来重新审视自1789以来关税的演变。我们记录了从国会设置到多边谈判的制度转变、关税法规粒度的稳步增长以及行政能力的扩大，以及从量关税的作用被低估，这些关税在美国历史上占据着突出的地位，其从价等价物随着价格机械地变化。我们讨论了这种关系对于我们如何解释过去的自由化事件以及关税效应的实证识别的影响。最后，我们概述了新数据如何推进关税设定的政治经济学以及贸易政策的宏观经济和分配后果的研究。

articles.title_en: Labor Market Responses to Tariffs: Frictions, Dynamics, and Policy Responses
articles.title_cn: 劳动力市场对关税的反应：摩擦、动态和政策反应
articles.abstract_en: This article introduces the evidence and associated modeling frameworks contemporary economists use to understand the effects of trade and trade policy on labor markets, with a particular emphasis on labor-market frictions and adjustment dynamics. The effects of trade shocks differ across industries, regions, and occupations, implying the presence of important adjustment frictions in labor markets, and these effects evolve slowly over time, implying the need for dynamic frameworks rationalizing slow transitions. After reviewing the key insights from this literature, we discuss policies aimed at mitigating costs to workers and ensuring that the gains from trade are shared more equitably.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了当代经济学家用来理解贸易和贸易政策对劳动力市场影响的证据和相关模型框架，特别强调劳动力市场摩擦和调整动态。贸易冲击的影响因行业、地区和职业而异，这意味着劳动力市场存在重要的调整摩擦，而且这些影响随着时间的推移缓慢演变，意味着需要动态框架来合理化缓慢的转型。在回顾了这些文献的主要见解后，我们讨论了旨在降低工人成本并确保更公平地分享贸易收益的政策。

articles.title_en: Should We Tax Trade? A Pigouvian Perspective
articles.title_cn: 我们应该对贸易征税吗？庇古的观点
articles.abstract_en: We develop a simple and intuitive Pigouvian perspective on optimal trade policy. Our approach unifies a wide range of rationales for taxing trade, from the classical optimal tariff argument to contemporary debates about global carbon emissions and geopolitics. We also clarify when trade policy intervention is warranted and when alternative domestic instruments should be used instead.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们对最优贸易政策提出了简单直观的庇古观点。我们的方法统一了对贸易征税的广泛理由，从经典的最优关税论点到当代有关全球碳排放和地缘政治的辩论。我们还澄清何时需要进行贸易政策干预以及何时应使用其他国内工具。

articles.title_en: The Incidence of Tariffs: Rates and Reality
articles.title_cn: 关税的发生率：税率与现实
articles.abstract_en: In 2025, statutory tariff rates on US imports rose to levels not seen in over one hundred years. What were the implications for prices? On the one hand, shipping lags, exemptions, and enforcement gaps kept the actual implemented rates at only half of the statutory rates, moderating the tariffs' impact. On the other hand, tariff pass-through to US import prices reached 92 percent, so the United States bore a large share of the costs. We study the incidence of the 2018–2019 and 2025 US tariffs and discuss implications for US sourcing, domestic manufacturing costs, and the dollar.
articles.abstract_cn: 2025，美国进口产品的法定关税税率升至一百多年来未见的水平。这对价格有何影响？一方面，运输滞后、豁免和执法差距使实际执行的税率仅为法定税率的一半，减轻了关税的影响。另一方面，关税对美国进口价格的转嫁达到92%，因此美国承担了很大一部分成本。我们研究 2018-2019 和 2025 美国关税的发生率，并讨论对美国采购、国内制造成本和美元的影响。

articles.title_en: Global Imbalances, Tariffs, and Industrial Policy
articles.title_cn: 全球失衡、关税和产业政策
articles.abstract_en: Global imbalances denote the distribution of countries' current account balances, identically equal to the difference between two forward-looking aggregate variables: national saving and domestic investment. Industrial and trade policies have traditionally not been considered important drivers of aggregate saving or investment, and therefore of current account balances. The former because most industrial policies are small in scope; the latter because permanent tariffs have no intertemporal effect in the textbook model, with an offsetting appreciation of the real exchange rate. The rapidly growing use of both industrial and trade policies in recent years calls for a reassessment. This paper presents a framework to think about the role of both policies. For industrial policy, we make the important distinction between the traditional sector-specific policies via subsidies or other targeted instruments ("micro industrial policy") and broader policies ("macro industrial policy") that aim to promote industrial developments and competitiveness through the deployment of more aggregate instruments such as financial repression, foreign reserve accumulation, or capital controls. A key finding is that micro industrial policy tends to increase external balances if it fails to raise aggregate productivity. By contrast, macro industrial policy can, under some conditions, boost the current account, forcing other countries to adjust. Yet, these policies often come at the cost of suppressed domestic consumption and possibly domestic welfare. Our analysis confirms that tariffs are a weak tool to improve current account balances. Finally, traditional macroeconomic drivers—such as fiscal policy, demographics or credit cycles—remain critical drivers of global imbalances, especially for the United States and China.
articles.abstract_cn: 全球失衡是指各国经常账户余额的分布，同样等于两个前瞻性总体变量：国民储蓄和国内投资之间的差额。传统上，工业和贸易政策不被视为总储蓄或投资的重要驱动因素，因此也不被视为经常账户余额的重要驱动因素。前者是因为大多数产业政策的范围较小；后者是因为大多数产业政策的范围较小。后者是因为永久关税在教科书模型中没有跨期效应，并会抵消实际汇率的升值。近年来，工业和贸易政策的使用迅速增加，需要重新评估。本文提出了一个思考这两项政策作用的框架。对于产业政策，我们对通过补贴或其他有针对性的工具（“微观产业政策”）的传统特定部门政策（“微观产业政策”）和更广泛的政策（“宏观产业政策”）进行了重要区分，后者旨在通过部署金融抑制、外汇储备积累或资本管制等更多总体工具来促进产业发展和竞争力。一个重要的发现是，如果微观产业政策不能提高总生产率，它往往会增加外部平衡。相比之下，宏观产业政策在某些情况下可以增加经常账户，迫使其他国家进行调整。然而，这些政策往往是以抑制国内消费和可能的国内福利为代价的。我们的分析证实，关税对于改善经常账户余额来说是一个较弱的工具。最后，财政政策、人口结构或信贷周期等传统宏观经济驱动因素仍然是全球失衡的关键驱动因素，尤其是对美国和中国而言。

articles.title_en: Evaluating the Fiscal and Distributional Implications of Tariffs
articles.title_cn: 评估关税的财政和分配影响
articles.abstract_en: The Trump administration has enacted a series of significant taxes on imports, including an across-the-board tariff on nearly all imports. Tariffs are now expected to raise nearly 1 percent of GDP in revenue. Given tariffs' growing importance as a source of revenue, it is important to understand their implications for federal finances and the wellbeing of households. This paper describes and reviews current revenue and distributional analyses of tariffs.
articles.abstract_cn: 特朗普政府对进口产品征收了一系列重大税款，包括对几乎所有进口产品征收全面关税。目前预计关税将增加近 1% 的 GDP 收入。鉴于关税作为收入来源的重要性日益增加，了解其对联邦财政和家庭福祉的影响非常重要。本文描述并回顾了当前的收入和关税分配分析。

articles.title_en: Correct (and Incorrect) Inference with a Single Instrumental Variable: Practical Takeaways from the Weak Instruments Literature
articles.title_cn: 使用单个工具变量进行正确（和不正确）的推断：弱工具文献的实用要点
articles.abstract_en: Most empirical economists have encountered the warning that instrumental variables can be "weak," but the underlying issues—what makes an instrument weak, why weakness distorts inference, and what to do about it—are less widely understood. This article offers an accessible introduction to the weak instruments problem for the common just-identified case of a single endogenous regressor and a single instrument. We explain why the usual two-stage least squares t -ratio and its "±1.96 times the standard error" confidence interval can yield incorrect inferences, much as homoskedasticity-only standard errors do when errors are not homoskedastic. We then describe practical, robust-to-weak-instrument solutions—including the Anderson-Rubin and tF methods—that deliver valid confidence intervals whatever the instrument's true strength, and we offer some do's and don'ts, notably why the popular " F greater than 10" rule has no theoretical justification in this setting.
articles.abstract_cn: 大多数实证经济学家都遇到过工具变量可能“弱”的警告，但根本问题——是什么导致工具弱，为什么弱会扭曲推论，以及如何应对——却不太被广泛理解。本文针对刚刚确定的单个内生回归量和单个工具的常见情况，对弱工具问题进行了简单易懂的介绍。我们解释了为什么通常的两阶段最小二乘 t 比及其“±1.96 乘以标准误差”置信区间可能会产生错误的推论，就像当误差不是同方差时仅同方差的标准误差一样。然后，我们描述实用的、稳健到弱的仪器解决方案（包括 Anderson-Rubin 和 tF 方法），无论仪器的真实强度如何，它们都能提供有效的置信区间，并且我们提供了一些注意事项，特别是为什么流行的“F 大于 10”规则在这种情况下没有理论依据。

articles.abstract_en: We develop a step-by-step guide to leniency (a.k.a. judge or examiner instrument) designs, drawing on recent econometric literatures. The unbiased jackknife instrumental variables estimator (UJIVE) is purpose-built for leveraging exogenous leniency variation, avoiding subtle biases even in the presence of many decision-makers or controls. We show how UJIVE can also be used to assess key assumptions underlying leniency designs, including quasi-random assignment and average first-stage monotonicity, and to probe the external validity of treatment effect estimates. We further discuss statistical inference, arguing that non-clustered standard errors are often appropriate. A reanalysis of Farre-Mensa et al. (2020), using quasi-random examiner assignment to estimate the value of patents to startups, illustrates our checklist.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们借鉴最近的计量经济学文献，制定了宽大处理（又称法官或审查员工具）设计的分步指南。无偏折刀工具变量估计器 (UJIVE) 是专门为利用外生宽大变异而构建的，即使在存在许多决策者或控制的情况下也能避免细微的偏差。我们展示了如何使用 UJIVE 来评估宽大设计背后的关键假设，包括准随机分配和平均第一阶段单调性，并探讨治疗效果估计的外部有效性。我们进一步讨论统计推断，认为非聚集标准误差通常是合适的。 Farre-Mensa 等人的重新分析。 （2020）使用准随机审查员分配来估计专利对初创企业的价值，说明了我们的清单。

articles.title_cn: 斯蒂芬妮·斯坦切娃 (Stefanie Stantcheva)，2025 克拉克奖章获得者
articles.abstract_en: The American Economic Association awarded the 2025 John Bates Clark Medal to Stefanie Stantcheva of Harvard University. Her research ranges widely in the field of public economics. It includes theoretical contributions to optimal income taxation, empirical contributions to the study of how income tax rates across countries and states affect the mobility of inventors and the level of innovation, and contributions in the development and execution of on-line surveys to measure respondents' beliefs about economic primitives, such as the distribution of income or the rate of inflation, and the way these beliefs influence policy preferences. She has demonstrated that randomized controlled trials can be embedded within on-line surveys and used to the way informational interventions and other treatments affect economic beliefs and policy preferences.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国经济协会将2025约翰·贝茨·克拉克奖章授予哈佛大学的斯蒂芬妮·斯坦切娃。她的研究广泛涉及公共经济学领域。它包括对最佳所得税的理论贡献，对研究不同国家和州的所得税税率如何影响发明者流动性和创新水平的实证贡献，以及对开发和执行在线调查的贡献，以衡量受访者对经济原语的信念，例如收入分配或通货膨胀率，以及这些信念影响政策偏好的方式。她证明，随机对照试验可以嵌入在线调查中，并用于研究信息干预和其他治疗方法影响经济信念和政策偏好的方式。
